issue.title: Test 8x long-context skew at qk=1.75
issue.body:
## TL;DR

Launch a production-priority v4-2048 treatment twin of the qk=1.75 262K context-extension run. Preserve the step-156000 checkpoint and training configuration while increasing the aggregate share of tokens from documents longer than 65,536 tokens from 14.943% to 43.405%.

## Description

The control extends the step-156000 cooldown checkpoint from 65,536 to 262,144 context for 1,000 steps at batch size 256. Within each phase-1 domain-by-quality component, the treatment includes the `>65,536` token partition eight times and the `<=65,536` partition once. The component is renormalized after repetition, so total token mass and outer domain-by-quality weights stay fixed.

The run resumes from `gs://marin-us-central2/grug/moe_67b_a2b_d2560_ep1_rep8_bs1024_seq65536_sw2k_v4_2048_muon_cooldown_step141k-a30ef8/checkpoints/step-156000/`. It reads the immutable `datakit/store/june-67b-a2b-length64k/2026.08.24` store through `experiments/grug/moe/moe_67b_a2b_d2560_ctxext_step156k_seq262k_bs256_ctx4_muon_qk175_long_context_skew.py`.

All variants use qk multiplier 1.75, MuonH, batch size 256, 67.1M tokens per step, `resume_data_offset=7,296,000`, and a `(replica=1, data=256, context=4, expert=1, model=1)` mesh. The learning rate decays linearly from 0.000264 to 0.0000528. Evaluation and permanent checkpoints occur every 250 steps.

## Hypothesis or Goal

Compare Paloma macro loss at steps 156250, 156500, 156750, and 157000 with the qk=1.75 control, 2x treatment, and 4x treatment. Track training loss, throughput, numerical stability, and worker failures over the same 1,000-step schedule.

## Status

Pinned source is in #8815. Verifying the launch contract before production submission.
